# Kano Lab (加納研究室)

> The Science Communication Laboratory at the Faculty of Education, Shiga University, Japan. Led by Professor Kei Kano (加納 圭). Three research areas: inclusive science communication and STEAM education; traditional and Indigenous knowledge for a sustainable society; responsible AI in education.

Japanese pages are at the site root; English pages are under /en/ with the same paths.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/): lab overview
- [Research](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/research/): the three research areas and past projects
- [UNESCO Chair](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/unesco-chair/): UNESCO Chair on STEAM education weaving traditional cultural resources and science
- [Workshops](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/workshops/): STEAM workshops for children, families and the public
- [Games & Books](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/games-books/): game-based teaching materials and books
- [People](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/people/): members
- [Join the Lab](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/join/): doctoral, JSPS fellow, visiting and collaborative research
- [Contact](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/contact/)
- [Access](https://sanorie-kanolab.github.io/kanolab-web/en/access/)
